servicePackages.title: Support that fits the work in front of you
servicePackages.intro: Choose a clear consultation or support package. No account is needed, and our team will confirm the scope, timing, and payment with you.
servicePackages.pricingIntro: Consultation prices cover advice and support time. Development, field work, and larger technical projects are assessed separately so you know the expected cost before we start.
rules: The minimum direct consultation price is 25,000 IQD.
Development and customization use a different rate from consultation.
Simple development may use package time at a 1.5x or 2x rate, after your approval.
Complex modules, integrations, migrations, upgrades, and server projects receive a separate quotation.
Emergency work outside normal business hours may cost 50% extra.
On-site work may include transportation fees and a minimum booking period.
Third-party licenses, hosting, and external services are not included.
servicePackages.assuranceText: We review the request, contact you using your preferred method, then confirm the final scope, timing, and payment. Submitting the form does not confirm an appointment.
